units.source_text: 他想过那种死也不会后悔的激烈生活。

en.t: He had imagined an intense way of life that he would not regret even if it led to death.

units.source_text: 可是他在养父养母和姑妈面前，依然小心谨慎的生活。

en.t: Yet in front of his adoptive father and mother and his aunt, he still lived carefully and cautiously.

units.source_text: 这让他的生活分裂成阴阳两面。。

en.t: This split his life into two sides, one shadowed and one bright.

units.source_text: 他望着某西服店里立着的一个人体模型，想他自己和这个模型有多大差别。

en.t: He looked at a mannequin standing in a certain suit shop and wondered how different he really was from it.

units.source_text: 但是意识之外的他——第二个他，早已把此种心情写入一篇短篇小说里了。

en.t: But the self outside his consciousness, his second self, had already written this feeling into a short story.
